title: Retail environment
slide_intent: Use shared identity elements to connect a room’s displays and surfaces so visitors recognize one coherent setting.
strategic_value: The symbol crop and recurring colors can make Swisscom’s retail environment recognizable across walls, counters and product displays.
demonstration: A wide store photograph shows white display fixtures, blue and red furniture accents, and a large red-and-blue symbol crop across the right wall beneath an exposed ceiling.
practical_value: Compare environmental graphics with furniture and merchandise to judge how much of the space carries the identity.

content_islands.name: Store depth and fixtures
content_islands.spec: Retain the long perspective through the shop and the white product display surfaces.

content_islands.name: Graphic wall
content_islands.spec: Place the large cropped red-and-blue symbol on the right wall, above and behind the products.

content_islands.name: Color accents
content_islands.spec: Preserve the blue foreground counters and red fixtures deeper in the room as repeated color cues.

ingredient.name: Environmental symbol crop
ingredient.role: Connect the retail interior to the wider identity.
ingredient.application: Extend a large symbol crop across a wall and repeat related colors in fixtures, as the photographed store demonstrates.
ingredient.scope: One retail example. The source does not supply required coverage percentages, fixture dimensions or a universal store plan.

reference_purposes.Expression: The store combines a large symbol crop with red and blue furniture accents.
reference_purposes.Application: The photograph shows the identity across wall graphics, product displays and fixtures in a retail interior.
